verdict.rationale: Rive's documented export flow centers on exporting .riv files for use across runtimes (web, mobile, game engines), not static production assets like PNG/SVG/PDF with per-layer presets, scales, or slices. Community evidence even highlights the absence of static/video asset export ('It's so insane they don't offer any way to export movie files', 'can I export video assets with this!?'), reinforcing that this design-export workflow is not supported.
